info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Banking Accounts Alerts-v4-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Alerts API allows users to retrieve alerts associated with their banking accounts. This endpoint provides notifications on various account activities, enabling consumers to stay informed about important updates and actions. Typical use cases include monitoring account status, receiving transaction alerts, and managing account-related notifications effectively. Designed for both individual and business banking clients, this API enhances user engagement and aids in proactive account management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of user alerts for account activities.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all alerts related to their account activities. Alerts may include notifications on account changes, transactions, and other relevant updates. You can filter alerts based on different criteria to streamline the response.
